projects.name: Self-Rising Robot
projects.summary: A physical two-servo robot that learns to right itself, built around an M5Atom Matrix with policies trained in simulation.
details: Includes physical self-standing and self-rising demos.
Explores on-device control and sim-to-real behavior.
The public repository includes multiple hardware iterations and videos.

projects.name: AI LEGO
projects.summary: Code-designed LEGO models with validation, build instructions, and animated assembly films.
details: Bolt the Brick Bot uses 138 standard pieces and has a 37-page instruction booklet.
The checker verifies collisions, stud connections, build order, connectivity, and whether the model stands after each step.
The showreel begins with a 3D booklet flip-through and then assembles every piece with procedural sound.

projects.name: San Francisco 49-Mile GPS Audio Tour
projects.summary: A native iOS driving companion that plays location-aware stories while the driver's navigation app remains in the foreground.
details: Covers 33 San Francisco landmarks with several road-aware trigger points for each stop.
Narration is pre-rendered and bundled for offline use.
The app keeps location and listening state on-device and has no account, analytics service, or runtime network dependency.

projects.name: Vanna
projects.summary: An open-source Python project for conversational analytics and natural-language access to data.
details: The work connects language models to governed data workflows.
Aditya's background includes building and shipping data and AI products for technical teams.

projects.name: The Sly Llama
projects.summary: A podcast and writing series about practical business and operating questions.
details: Topics include bookkeeping, international payments risk, software spend, product copy, and account-executive training.
